name: setup-status
description: Return the Setup checklist: each step's live status (done / pending / deferred), a one-line detail for pending steps, and setup_complete. It is the same checklist the console's Setup page shows. Call this at the start of every setup session and after any change. Never guess at setup state — always call this.

outputs.setup_for: 'self' | 'other' — whether the operator is setting Curia up for themselves or for someone else (an absent operator means 'self')
outputs.setup_complete: boolean — every required step is done; unlocks Start onboarding
outputs.missing: string[] — ids of required steps not yet done
outputs.tasks: tasks with status, optional (true for optional extras), detail (why a pending step is pending), handoff surface, credential_how_to, docs_url; restart_required: true when the step is saved but Curia must restart before it works; done_means: "credentials_saved" on key-based tasks (those with vault_keys), where done means the keys are saved, not that the integration is running
outputs.summary: { total: number, done: number, pending: number, deferred: number }
